pinyin: qiān lǐ zhī xíng, shǐ yú zú xià
gloss: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
teaser: Discover how this ancient wisdom encourages us to take that first step towards our goals.
script: Welcome to Chengyu Bites — your quick summary on Chinese 成语. Discover how this ancient wisdom encourages us to take that first step towards our goals. [break 1s] The phrase is: 千里之行，始于足下, qiān lǐ zhī xíng, shǐ yú zú xià. [break 1s] 千 (qiān) - thousand [break 0.5s] 里 (lǐ) - miles [break 0.5s] 之 (zhī) - 'of' or possessive particle [break 0.5s] 行 (xíng) - journey or to walk [break 0.5s] ，(,) - comma [break 0.5s] 始 (shǐ) - to begin [break 0.5s] 于 (yú) - at or in [break 0.5s] 足 (zú) - foot [break 0.5s] 下 (xià) - below or under. [break 1s] The full idiom again: 千里之行，始于足下 - literally means 'a journey of a thousand miles begins at your feet,' and figuratively, it emphasizes the importance of taking the first step in any endeavor. [break 1s] Here’s the story behind it: [break 1.5s] This idiom originates from the Dao De Jing, a foundational text of Daoism written by Laozi. It highlights the notion that no matter how grand a goal might be, progress starts with small, manageable actions. This wisdom has inspired many to pursue their dreams, reminding us that every big achievement begins with a single step. [break 1.5s] Example 1: 做事情要从小做起，千里之行，始于足下。 [break 1s] You should start small when doing things; a journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step. [break 1s] Example 2: 学习新技能时，千里之行，始于足下。 [break 1s] When learning a new skill, a journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step. [break 1s] Example 3: 他明白了，千里之行，始于足下，决定从今天开始锻炼。 [break 1s] He understood that a journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step and decided to start exercising today. [break 1s] So remember, 千里之行，始于足下 - a journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step. Thank you for listening to Chengyu Bites! See you next time for another idiom. [break 1s]
